title: SW Sliderman slider document, schema version 1
description: Documentation of the document contract. Authoritative are assets/shared/validate.ts and src/Domain/DocumentValidator.php (identical rules, shared fixtures in tests/fixtures/documents). Additional rules not expressible here: IDs of slides and layers are unique within the document; fontRef must reference fontRefs[].id; breakpoints: mobile.minWidth = 0 < tablet.minWidth < desktop.minWidth; fontRefs[].weight is a multiple of 100; a timed exit starts at or after the end of the entrance; string lengths count Unicode code points; the encoded document is at most 524288 bytes.
